sup:DEMO-J1.text:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal and are very keen to win your business and demonstrate our capabilities as a reliable, long-term partner. For this position, our offer includes a price of €16.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

We look forward to the opportunity of working together and building a successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We are following up on our previous offer as we have not yet received your feedback.

For your reference, our offer stands at a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, and delivery EXW. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please let us know if you have any questions or if we can proceed with the proposed terms. We are very keen to build a strong partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and look forward to working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner

move.subject: SH-220 – lead time and commercial terms
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your offer offer:DEMO-C1-0. Your standard lead time of 45 days exceeds our maximum of 42 days, so we need a firm lead time of 35 days or less.

We hold a competing offer, offer:DEMO-J1-0, with a lead time of 28 days.

We have also received a quote, , with DAP delivery and 60 days payment.

Please see our proposed term sheets attached. Could you also share a cost breakdown for SH-220 and tell us your earliest possible lead time? Are there any cheaper process or packaging variants you could offer?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:

move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quote offer:DEMO-J1-0 and the clear, practical terms.

We are comparing several offers for SH-220 over the 24-month term, and at present your unit price is not the most competitive one we hold. We would like to give you the chance to improve it. Could you also share a rough cost breakdown for SH-220, for example material, machining and setup? Are there any cheaper process or packaging variants you could offer?

move.body:
